**EMEA revenue: about 30 million** (reported: 28.7 million)

Rounding up to 30 million adds 1.3 million, which overstates the figure by about 4.5% (1.3 ÷ 28.7). That is within your 5% limit, so the rounded figure works for the headline.

The report doesn't specify a currency, so I've left the figures unitless.
